paper.title: Metformin attenuates multiple myeloma cell proliferation and encourages apoptosis by suppressing METTL3-mediated m6A methylation of THRAP3, RBM25, and USP4.

source.title: Metformin attenuates multiple myeloma cell proliferation and encourages apoptosis by suppressing METTL3-mediated m6A methylation of THRAP3, RBM25, and USP4.

study.design: Primary H929/MM.1S culture pharmacology and gene perturbation plus public expression-data mining and H929 nude-mouse xenograft
study.normalComparator: nPCs as source reports ATCC purchase, catalog/donor identity not provided; baseline m6A comparator, not parallel metformin safety
study.omics: GSE29023/GPL570,92MM/23normal blood samples as reported, not freshly independently checked

animal.model: H929 xenograft, source subcutaneous into peritoneum wording unresolved
animal.treatmentMethods: Metformin2mg/mL drinking water orally from1week after inoculation

H929 methylation enrichment, expression and RNA stability

downstreamMapping.purpose: Private metformin MM cell/xenograft m6A mechanism candidate with computational context, not clinical efficacy

reviewInputs.answer: Metformin-associated MM cell/xenograft effects with METTL3/targetRNA perturbations; model/assay/dose/N/site-specificity limits remain.

sourceQualifications.description: H929/MM.1S culture, H929-specific downstream molecular assays and male immunodeficient subcutaneous xenografts, not clinical MM efficacy. Source calls MM cultures adherent/confluent and nPCs purchased ATCC without catalog/donor information; these details are not independently resolved or silently repaired.

Actual culture range0/2.5/5/10/20/40mM,48h. Figure1/2 captions omit40 despite graphs/text including40; main functional10/20mM. Growth readouts0/24/48/72h versus CCK8 generic methods through120h; no extra120h results invented. No high-dose normal-cell therapeutic index or clinically achievable exposure established.

CCK8OD450 is metabolic viability/proliferation surrogate, not direct cell counts. AnnexinV/PE provides separate apoptosis readout; representative flow plots not exact aggregate means. Five wells and figureN3 are not15 independent biological experiments; hierarchy unknown, no graph-digitized percentages.

Higher baseline global m6A in MM versus nPCs, lower after metformin. METTL3 down, WTAP up, ALKBH5 up onlyMM.1S, notH929. Figure2d-e also shows FTO down in both, although narrative emphasizes other enzymes; METTL14 near unchanged. Not uniform suppression of all writers or demethylases.

METTL3 OE approximately3fold/noMet and4fold/Met as reported, promotes growth/lower apoptosis, partly offsets metformin effect. Body also describes metformin reversing OE promotion, while figure supports partial rescue both directions; no full abolishment or proof sole target. Transfection24h before drug versus caption pre-treatment wording not collapsed.

Figure3f-g compares metformin+NCshRNA against metformin+METTL3shRNA: no significant extra proliferation/apoptosis effect from KD on this treated background. This is not a full factorial demonstration that metformin loses all effect after KD. Likewise Fig5/6 treated-background nulls do not alone prove necessary/sufficient sole mechanism.

Methods selects2 best shRNAs each METTL3 sh933/sh1365, THRAP3sh81/sh174,RBM25sh5054/sh6468,USP4sh5896/sh6322; figures typically display pooled generic labels, not independent shown replication for each sequence. Sequences in unread supplement, no resistant rescue/catalytic-mutant specificity or off-target exclusion accepted.

GSE29023/GPL57092MM/23normal blood samples as source, not own115 treated patients or independently checked donor uniqueness. Heatmap caption8normal/8MM subset selection unexplained, not all115. Threshold abslogFC>=.5/adjustedP<.05;21601DEGs/300upregulated pathway subset/22hub selections not independently reproduced.

Narrative lists8 downregulated transcripts THRAP3/TOP1/RBM25/RPL14/USP4/MYO1C/PNISR/EP300,14others unchanged, but Figure4h has9 protein bands includingSNRNP200; later text says9 candidates. Caption calls8 proteins then lists22 gene names. Retain8/9/list discrepancies, not assert all22 suppressed.

GO/STRING/Cytoscape hub/pathway findings are selection/enrichment context, not metformin targets validated in patients. DAVID versus clusterProfiler descriptions and complex graph do not independently reproduce methods; no original dataset/code retrieved.

SRAMP GGACT predicted coordinates and Starbase motif/3UTR claims are computational, not site-specific direct METTL3 binding or exact catalytic mapping. Figure5 motif coordinate labels differ in scale/ordering from predicted-site text; not reconciled to verified transcript/genomic coordinates. No mutant-site assay or METTL3-RNA direct-binding IP established here.

MeRIP anti-m6A versusIgG,input-normalized target enrichment and global kit signal fall with Met/KD in H929. Antibody enrichment does not establish single-base occupancy or direct binding of METTL3. No additional decrease under Met+KD is a treated-background null, not saturation/necessity proof.

THRAP3/RBM25/USP4 expression decreases with Met/KD; METTL3OE partially restores Met-suppressed expression and actinomycinD5ug/mL decay curves over0-6h. No fitted exact half-lives or binding-site causal m6A mechanism independently established. DNMT3A/B promoter methylation and WTAP homeostasis explanations are cited/speculated, not own demonstrated pathway.

H929 downstream geneKD counteracts METTL3OE growth/apoptosis effects, without significant cross-gene transcript changes. On metformin background, individual targetKD shows no significant extra transcript/proliferation/apoptosis changes. Do not reframe as tripleKD, synergy or proof all metformin effects pass through exactly these genes. Fig6c caption mislabelsTHRAP3 versus displayedUSP4 retained.

Methods4arms5miceeach versus Figure7N3, three pictured tumors/group and expression plot points not reconciled. No inference that missing mice died/were excluded; animalattrition/censoring/analyzedN unresolved. Random division reported, method/blinding/power not provided.

Methods orally administered2mg/mL drinking water from1weekpostinoculation versus results250mg/kg and metformin injection language, abstract injection. No measured intake/bodyweight schedule or conversion equates regimens. Subcutaneous into peritoneum wording ambiguous. Keep dose/route and implantation discrepancies unresolved.

Figure7 Met lowers tumor volume/weight and METTL3OE increases growth, combined treatment partially offsets each effect. Day35 tumor burden/expression not animal survival or clinical benefit; tumor-expressionN3 does not resolve5/group methods. No raw tumor values, fixed-time effects/CI or exact aggregate weights digitized, no in-vivo KD sensitivity test as authors acknowledge.

Most figures meanSEM N3 with selected thresholds, no exact complete means/CI, global multiplicity/posthoc plan/power/blinded scoring/rawFCS/blots. Monitoring skin/behavior described without numerical adverse events, bodyweight/renal/metabolic safety not established. No full scientific/integrity acceptance or human dose advice.

Clinical/metformin-benefit statements and other cancer mechanisms are background not this study clinical results. Grimaldi reference12 is T-ALL, Wang13 ALL perspective not MM progression-free trial, and ref41parathyroid/ref54drug-eluting glioma beads do not obviously substantiate cited THRAP3/USP4 claims. Preserve mismatches without external repair or transferred primary acceptance.

Fujian medical/animal ethics approval as reported withoutID, author publication consent is not patient consent. Fujian2021J011444/Longyan2020LYF17032funding, no potential conflict as declared, data conditional reasonable request not verified public. Own19text and7figurepages read; supplemental shRNA/primers/rawomics/FCS/blots/protocol/current corrections unchecked, no acquisition.
